title: H3283 (126th General Assembly): CWP on college campuses

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, South Carolina); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Carolina text (Introduced, 2024-12-05; official copy, https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess126_2025-2026/prever/3283_20241205.htm (LegiScan doc 3031394))
provenance.note: Introduced text of 2024-12-05; no passage vote. In Section 2 the words 'or college' after 'school' are struck from item (5), so college athletic events leave the list of places where handguns are barred.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Section 16-23-420(A)): The provisions contained in this subsection related to any premises or property owned, operated, or controlled by a college, university, technical college, or other postsecondary institution do not apply to a person who is authorized to carry a concealed weapon pursuant to Article 4, Chapter 31, Title 23.
Section 2 (Section 16-23-20(A)): It is unlawful, whether or not the person has a concealed weapon permit, for anyone to carry about the person any handgun, whether concealed or not, unless otherwise specifically authorized by law into a: ... (5) school athletic event not related to firearms;
